title: GenCorp’s P520-M sales surge raises questions over VP Duterte ties
summary: MANILA, Philippines — How can GenCorp Industries Inc., a company linked to Vice President Sara Z. Duterte, allegedly increase its annual sales from P28 million to more than P520 million in four years…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — How can GenCorp Industries Inc., a company linked to Vice President Sara Z. Duterte, allegedly increase its annual sales from P28 million to more than P520 million in four years despite having only P1.25 million in paid-in capital? Former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, posed this question during a press conference on Wednesday. According to Barbers, GenCorp recorded P28 million in sales in 2021, which jumped to P300 million in 2022, the year Duterte assumed office as vice president.
